wear_fiber_endpoint.requirement: At least one visible frayed cuff boundary with separate loose fibers clearly attached to the cuff material, not disconnected specks.

creasing_continuity.requirement: Visible angular crease/ridge and trough crossing a coherent continuous front coat panel; must differ from mottled damage and cast wall shadow.

wet_weathering.requirement: Rain-darkened lower coat region and damp droplets visible on the same coat; dark color alone is insufficient.
wet_weathering.evidence: Discrete water beads and localized dark wet spots sit on the lower front coat above the hem, visibly distinct from the drier upper cloth. Moisture is supported by droplets and bounded surface state, not black garment color alone.

abrasion_boundary.requirement: Paler rubbed abrasion on the lapel edge with adjacent intact cloth establishing the difference.
abrasion_boundary.evidence: The lapel at image right has a pale rubbed/frayed border beside darker intact cloth on the same lapel and coat. The edge, worn patch and adjacent cloth remain visible together.

whole_scene.impression_before_control_labels: A rain-damp, guarded figure in a heavily worn dark coat pauses with a sealed envelope at a stairwell door, under warm lamp and cool lower-stair light.
strengths: The face and envelope organize attention while the stair and closed door make the pause understandable.
Coat fraying, localized rubbing and water beads have visible owners and do not read as disconnected decoration.
weaknesses: Broad pale wear marks dominate the front panel and obscure whether a crease has ridge/trough relief.
The visible envelope grip exchanges the intended right-thumb seal-check emphasis for a two-handed hold.
whole_scene.genre_claim_limit: A confidential-return or espionage-like impression is plausible; occupation, mission, intent, violence or actual preceding events are not established by pixels.
